I don't think the team note is right. Unlawful homicide is not a commercial activity, so it is a public act (jure imperii), which rules out C; and under *Arrest Warrant* (ICJ, 2002) a sitting minister keeps personal immunity abroad even for serious crimes, which rules out B. My answer stays A, with D as the fuller statement if immunity is also in view.

CONFIDENCE: 40
